pr_title: Bluetooth: tester: Fix 3 GAP qualification tests
pr_body:
Fix the following 3 failing tests:

- SM/SLA/SIP/BV-01-C
- SM/MAS/SIP/BV-02-C
- SM/MAS/PKE/BV-01-C

Fixes #22929.
Fixes #22927.
Fixes #22930.
pr_comments: Downgraded my comment to a suggestion instead.

issue_context.title: PTS: Test Framework: Bluetooth:  SM/MAS/SIP/BV-02-C-INCONCLUSIV
issue_context.body:
Describe the bug
Zephyr set IO capability to KeyboardOnly instead of KeyboardDisplay

To Reproduce
run auto-pts

Expected behavior    
IO capability needs to be set to KeyboardDisplay

[SM_MAS_SIP_BV-02-C-INCONCLUSIV.zip](https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/files/4223855/SM_MAS_SIP_BV-02-C-INCONCLUSIV.zip)
comments: @aescolar this sounds more like a test setup error than a stack bug, do you agree?

Is the high priority really justified? I just took a look at `get_io_capa()` in `host/smp.c` and it *is* able to return KeyboardOnly, so this looks more like an auto-pts or tester app issue, and should therefore not be high priority (since the stack poses no obstacle for qualification in this particular case)

review_comments:
With this option we can set the MITM bit based on the security level, maybe we should switch the security level we call `bt_conn_set_security` with based on this command?

At the moment we always call with `BT_SECURITY_L2`, we could switch to `BT_SECURITY_L3` when mitm is requested by the test.
That's a good idea,  but I wonder if this would have unexpected consequences elsewhere in other tests? not sure, just thinking out loud

This is a new command, so if the default is L2, and using this command would change it to L3 then there shouldn't be any issues with the tests. If anything then`CONFIG_BT_SMP_ENFORCE_MITM=n` is the change I would question if had unexpected consequences for the tests.
